title: Design app architecture and component structure
description: Based on research findings, design the app architecture: 1) Choose UI framework (Compose vs XML) 2) Define data flow pattern 3) Plan component hierarchy 4) Document technical decisions

title: Build browser picker UI
description: Create the browser selection interface: 1) List/grid of available browsers with icons 2) Tap to select and launch 3) Optional 'Always use this browser' checkbox 4) Handle empty state (no browsers) 5) Material Design styling

title: Final polish and release preparation
description: Prepare for release: 1) Add app icon and branding 2) ProGuard/R8 configuration 3) Performance optimization 4) Accessibility audit 5) Create release build

title: Research Android 12+ browser/link handling changes
description: Research how Android 12+ changed default app handling for links. Understand: 1) Why app picker no longer shows for http/https intents 2) How apps can register as browser alternatives 3) Domain verification requirements 4) Best practices for browser selector apps

title: Implement unit and integration tests
description: Add test coverage: 1) Unit tests for browser detection logic 2) Unit tests for data models 3) Integration tests for intent handling 4) UI tests for picker interaction

title: Configure AndroidManifest intent filters for link handling
description: Set up manifest to intercept http/https links: 1) Add VIEW action intent filter 2) Configure BROWSABLE category 3) Add http/https schemes 4) Handle package visibility queries for Android 11+ 5) Consider domain verification if needed

title: Implement browser detection service
description: Create service/utility to detect installed browsers: 1) Query PackageManager for apps handling http/https VIEW intents 2) Filter out our own app from results 3) Extract app name, icon, package info 4) Handle edge cases (no browsers installed)

title: Add user preferences storage
description: Implement preference storage: 1) Remember last used browser 2) Store 'always use' default selection 3) Track usage counts for smart sorting 4) Use DataStore or SharedPreferences 5) Add settings screen to clear defaults

title: Browser Chooser Application
description: Main epic: Build an Android app that intercepts link opens and presents a browser picker dialog. Addresses Android 12+ behavior that forces default browser selection instead of showing app picker.

title: Implement browser launch logic
description: Handle launching the selected browser: 1) Create intent with original URL 2) Set explicit component for selected browser 3) Handle launch failures gracefully 4) Finish picker activity after launch

title: Create BrowserInfo data model
description: Create data class to represent installed browsers: 1) Package name 2) App label/name 3) App icon (Drawable) 4) Activity component name 5) Optional: usage count for sorting

title: Research modern Android app architecture patterns
description: Research latest best practices for Android development: 1) Jetpack Compose vs XML layouts 2) ViewModel + StateFlow patterns 3) Dependency injection (Hilt/Koin) 4) Material Design 3 components 5) Package visibility (queries) in Android 11+

title: Add settings/configuration screen
description: Create settings UI: 1) View/clear default browser selection 2) Toggle 'remember choice' behavior 3) About section with app info 4) Accessibility considerations
